
  Little has changed since. Alacritty and kitty push glyphs through GPUs;
  Windows Terminal draws on a compositor. Yet all of them still speak escape
  sequences designed for a discontinued Massachusetts machine, and still
  introduce themselves as xterm-256color. We compute inside a careful
  reenactment of 1978.

  ---
  That's ~200 words. Happy to adjust the depth, era focus, or tone if you want a
  different cut.
